_doc: What styleboard/build.py (the README's Markdown) and styleboard/art/readme.mjs (its pictures) must agree on. Pictures are docs/readme/station-<NN>-<en|zh>-<light|dark>.webp, cards/<slug>-poster.webp with cards/<slug>-<lang>-<theme>.webp (its caption), thanks/<id>-poster.webp with thanks/<id>-<lang>-<theme>.webp, opuscar98-<lang>-<theme>.webp, end-<lang>-<theme>.webp, cover-<lang>.webp.
